biological_replicate.evidence: Ten lymph node metastases (South-Swedish Malignant Melanoma Biobank) were subjected to global protein expression analysis using two proteomics approaches (with/without orthogonal fractionation).

experimental_design.evidence: inferred: The aim of the present study was to build a protein sequence database in metastatic melanoma, searching for novel, relevant biomarkers.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: The tumor tissues used were lymph nodes metastases from 10 MM patients undergoing surgery at Lund University Hospital, Sweden.

number_of_fractions.evidence: 50 μg of peptides were fractionated into 6 fractions, approximately 8.3 μg in each fraction

number_of_samples.evidence: The tumor tissues used were lymph nodes metastases from 10 MM patients undergoing surgery at Lund University Hospital, Sweden.

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: Each sample was analysed in three separate technical replicates.

technical_replicate.evidence: Each sample was analysed in three separate technical replicates.
